en: Abu Nuwas al-Hasan ibn Hani al-Hakami
tr: Ebû Nüvâs el-Hasen b. Hânî el-Hakemî
ar: أبو نواس الحسن بن هانئ الحكمي

description.tr: En büyük Arapça şair — şarap ve aşk şiirleriyle sarayları skandalize etti, 1001 Gece'de karakter olarak göründü, 1.200 yıl sonra hâlâ yasaklı || Ebû Nüvâs, Abbasi Bağdat'ının radikal kültürel özgürlüğünü temsil eder. || [Tarih notu] Wagner'in Abu Nuwas (1965) çalışması kritik biyografiyi oluşturdu.
description.en: Greatest Arabic-language poet — scandalised courts with wine and love poems, appeared as character in 1001 Nights, still banned in parts of the Arab world 1,200 years later || Abu Nuwas represents the radical cultural freedom of Abbasid Baghdad. His khamriyyat (wine poetry) deliberately broke with pre-Islamic qasida conventions, replacing desert nostalgia with urban sophistication. The source notes he spent most of his life 'in pursuit not of progress, but of pleasure.' He remains controversial: still banned in some countries, yet considered by many scholars the finest Arabic poet ever. || [Historiographical note] Wagner's Abu Nuwas (1965) established the critical biography. His appearance in 1001 Nights cemented popular fame but obscured the literary sophistication that makes him a major world poet.
description.ar: أعظم شاعر بالعربية — أثار الجدل بقصائد الخمر والغزل || يمثل أبو نواس الحرية الثقافية الراديكالية لبغداد العباسية. خمرياته كسرت عمدًا تقاليد القصيدة الجاهلية
